sloka: ततस्तु तं वानरवीरमुख्यं महाबलं मारुततुल्यवेगम् ।महामतिं वायुसुतं वरिष्ठं प्रतुष्टुवुर्देवगणाश्च सर्वे ।। 5.54.47 ।।।।
transliteration: tatastu taṁ vānaravīramukhyaṁ mahābalaṁ mārutatulyavegam ।mahāmatiṁ vāyusutaṁ variṣṭhaṁ pratuṣṭuvurdevagaṇāśca sarve ।। 5.54.47 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman destroyed the garden, killed the demons, burnt the city of Lanka and was shining with delight
